explanation: The observed Job-2 priorities lose upstream provenance: every priority row has upstream_rank 0 even though the evidence_sources handoff contains ranks 1 through 8. The downstream prioritize function keys provenance by evidence_sources.record_id and looks it up using coverage record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08. The supplied upstream assemble_provenance function emits evidence_sources.record_id from source_id instead of the demand record_id, producing s01 through s08 and breaking that handoff. This violates the requirement to preserve record identities/provenance order; Job 2 is downstream of the malformed evidence_sources input.
cited_evidence: Job-2 input evidence_sources record_id values are s01 through s08 while Job-2 needs and coverage record_id values are n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed Job-2 priorities all show upstream_rank: 0 despite evidence_sources ranks 1 through 8.
assemble_provenance source: records.append({'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index})
prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id', '') and looks it up with coverage.get('record_id', '').
